items: Coins or more for various payments (600)
Bag of Salt from a Slayer Master, or an empty bucket to get some
Waterskin(4), bring a few to avoid drinking it
1 x Linen or 30 coins to buy some
rewards: Access to the city of Sophanem.
Ability to take carpet rides from Pollnivneach to Sophanem and Menaphos.

st.t: With your cat following you (drop it from your inventory), talk to the Wanderer west of the Agility Pyramid.
s: Why? What's your problem with it?
i: Waterskin(4), bring a few to avoid drinking it

st.t: Talk to the Wanderer again with the required items.
s: Yes. I have them all here.
i: Waterskin(4), bring a few to avoid drinking it
Waterskin(4), bring a few to avoid drinking it
Coins or more for various payments (600)
Bag of Salt from a Slayer Master, or an empty bucket to get some

st.t: If you aren't in Sophanem yet, enter the rock just north-east of the Wanderer's tent. Use this rock whenever you need to get back in. Then enter the pyramid in the south of Sophanem, through the door with a cat on it.
Follow the path until you reach a pit, and jump it. Move using the minimap to avoid all the traps.
Attempt to open the western door.
With your cat following you (drop it from your inventory), talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem and answer its riddle with '9.'.
Talk to the High Priest in the south west of Sophanem.
With your cat following you, go to the pyramid in the south of Sophanem. Long-press the door with a cat on it and choose Open.
Follow the path again until you reach a pit, and jump it. Move using the minimap to avoid all the traps.
Try picking up the canopic jars in the north west room until a level 75-81 enemy spawns. Kill them. You can safespot them on the central table.
Try picking up the canopic jars in the north west room again.
Jump back over the pit with the jar.
Jump back over to the north side of the pit. Move using the minimap to avoid all the traps inside the pyramid.
Solve the door puzzle again.
Drop the canopic jar in the spot you took it from.
Leave the pyramid and return to the High Priest.
Talk to the Embalmer just south of the High Priest.
i: Bag of Salt from a Slayer Master, or an empty bucket to get some

st.t: Get some linen. You can buy some from Raetul in east Sophanem for 30 coins.

Only if you brought an empty bucket instead of a bag of salt: crawl through the hole in Sophanem's east wall to leave the town, and fill the bucket with salt water from the lake north of Sophanem. Go back in through the rocks on the east side of the Wanderer's tent, then use the bucket of saltwater on the suntrap in the south east of Sophanem to get salt. Otherwise, skip this step.
Talk to the Embalmer again just south of the High Priest.
i: Bag of Salt from a Slayer Master, or an empty bucket to get some

st.t: Talk to the Carpenter in the east of Sophanem until he gives you the holy symbol.
s: Alright, I'll get the wood for you.

i: Bag of Salt from a Slayer Master, or an empty bucket to get some
1 x Linen or 30 coins to buy some

st.t: With your cat following you, go to the pyramid in the south of Sophanem. Long-press the door with a cat on it and choose Open.
Follow the path again until you reach a pit, and jump it. Move using the minimap to avoid all the traps.
Enter the east room.
Use the unholy symbol on a sarcophagus.
Leave the east room.
Jump over the pit.
Enter the east room again.
Kill the possessed priest. Pray protect from magic against the priest.
Talk to the High Priest in the north east room of the pyramid.
Leave the pyramid and witness a cutscene at the exit.
Return to the High Priest in the south west of Sophanem to finish the quest.
